entries.title: pixel_adaptive_charging.md
entries.content:
# Adaptive Charging

## Overview
Protects battery health by learning your schedule and slowing overnight charging.

## When to Use
- Charging phone overnight
- Want to extend long-term battery health
- Regular charging schedule

## Steps
- Go to Settings → Battery → Adaptive preferences
- Enable Adaptive charging
- Charge phone overnight as usual
- Phone learns your wake time

## How It Works
- Delays full charge until you typically wake up
- Reduces time at 100% (stresses battery less)
- Only activates when plugged in before sleep
- Shows "Fully charged by [time]" on lock screen

entries.content:

- Requires consistent charging schedule to learn
- Best for overnight charging
- Doesn't affect maximum charge capacity
- Protects long-term battery health

entries.title: pixel_battery_save.md
entries.content:
# How to Save Battery on Pixel

## Overview
Extend Pixel battery life using built-in power saving features.

## When to Use
- Battery draining fast
- Need phone to last longer
- Traveling without charger

entries.title: pixel_battery_save.md
entries.content:
When to Use
- Battery draining fast
- Need phone to last longer
- Traveling without charger ## Steps
- Enable Battery Saver: Settings → Battery → Battery Saver → Toggle on
- Enable Adaptive Battery: Settings → Battery → Adaptive preferences → Adaptive Battery
- Reduce brightness or enable Adaptive brightness
- Turn off Always-On Display: Settings → Display → Lock screen → Disable
- Enable Dark theme: Settings → Display → Dark theme
- Disable 5G: Settings → Network → SIMs → Preferred network → LTE
- Turn off Bluetooth/Wi-Fi when not needed
- Set shorter screen timeout: Settings → Display → Screen timeout → 30 seconds

entries.title: pixel_bluetooth_fix.md
entries.content:
# Fix Bluetooth Issues

## Overview
Troubleshoot Bluetooth pairing and connection problems.

## When to Use
- Bluetooth device won't pair
- Audio cutting out
- Device disconnecting

## Steps
- Toggle Bluetooth off and on
- Forget device: Settings → Connected devices → Tap device → Forget
- Re-pair device
- Restart both phone and Bluetooth device
- Check Bluetooth device battery
- Move closer (within 30 feet)
- Reset network settings if nothing works

entries.content:

- Move closer (within 30 feet)
- Reset network settings if nothing works ## Notes
- Remove other paired devices that might interfere
- Disable battery optimization for audio apps

- Check for phone software updates

entries.title: pixel_camera_fix.md
entries.content:
# Fix Camera Issues

## Overview
Troubleshoot camera app crashes and photo quality problems.

## When to Use
- Camera app crashes
- Black screen in camera
- Photos are blurry

## Camera Crashes Fix
- Force close Camera app and reopen
- Clear cache: Settings → Apps → Camera → Storage → Clear cache
- Update Camera app via Play Store
- Restart phone
- Clear app data (resets camera settings)

## Blurry Photos Fix
- Clean camera lens with soft cloth
- Tap to focus on subject
- Hold phone steady
- Use Night Sight in low light
- Check lens isn't blocked by case

- Hold phone steady
- Use Night Sight in low light
- Check lens isn't blocked by case ## Notes
- Black screen may be hardware issue if fixes don't work

- Update to latest software

## Overview
Copy apps, photos, messages, and settings from old phone to new Pixel.

## When to Use
- Setting up new Pixel
- Switching from old Android
- Upgrading Pixel models

## Steps
- Power on new Pixel
- Follow setup wizard
- Choose Express (all data) or Customize (select items)
- Use Quick Switch Adapter or cable for fastest transfer
- Or restore from cloud backup

## What Transfers
- Apps and app data
- Photos and videos
- Contacts and messages
- Settings and wallpaper
- Wi-Fi passwords

entries.title: pixel_factory_reset.md
entries.content:
# Factory Reset Pixel

## Overview
Erase all data and restore phone to original state.

## When to Use
- Selling or giving away phone
- Persistent software issues
- Starting fresh

## Backup First
- Settings → Google → Backup → Ensure backup is on
- Sync photos to Google Photos
- Note app-specific data

## Steps
- Go to Settings → System → Reset options
- Tap Erase all data (factory reset)
- Tap Erase all data to confirm
- Enter PIN if prompted
- Wait for completion

entries.title: pixel_factory_reset.md
entries.content:
data (factory reset)
- Tap Erase all data to confirm
- Enter PIN if prompted
- Wait for completion ## Reset via Recovery (if phone won't boot)
- Power off completely
- Hold Power + Volume Down until bootloader
- Navigate to Recovery mode with Volume buttons
- Press Power to select
- Select Wipe data/factory reset

## Notes
- Deletes ALL data permanently
- Cannot be undone
- Backup photos and important files first

entries.content:
# Find My Device - Locate Lost Pixel

## Overview
Locate, lock, or erase a lost Pixel phone remotely.

## Setup (Before Losing)
- Settings → Google → Find Hub
- Enable Allow device to be located
- Join Find network

## When Lost
- Go to android.com/find on any device
- Sign in with Google account
- Select your Pixel

## Actions
- Play Sound: Ring even if silent
- Secure Device: Lock with message
- Erase Device: Delete all data remotely

# Fingerprint Setup

## Overview
Set up fingerprint unlock for fast, secure device access.

## When to Use
- Want quick unlock without PIN
- Need biometric security
- Setting up new Pixel

## Steps
- Go to Settings → Security & privacy → Device unlock
- Tap Fingerprint Unlock
- Enter PIN/password
- Touch fingerprint sensor repeatedly until complete
- Register multiple fingers for convenience

## Tips for Better Recognition
- Register same finger twice for improved accuracy
- Ensure finger is dry and clean
- Clean sensor regularly
- Register fingers in different positions

entries.title: pixel_force_restart.md
entries.content:
# Force Restart Pixel

## Overview
Restart an unresponsive or frozen Pixel phone.

## When to Use
- Screen is frozen
- Phone not responding to touch
- Apps completely stuck
- Normal restart not working

## Steps
- Press and hold Power + Volume Up together
- Hold for 10-15 seconds
- Phone will vibrate and restart
- Release buttons when Google logo appears

## Notes
- Works even if screen is frozen
- Does not delete any data
- Equivalent to removing battery
- Try normal restart first: Power → Restart

entries.content:
# Now Playing - Music Recognition

## Overview
Automatically identifies music playing around you on lock screen.

## When to Use
- Want to know song name automatically
- Identify music in public places
- Build history of songs heard

## Steps
- Go to Settings → Sound & vibration → Now Playing
- Enable Now Playing
- Song names appear on lock screen automatically
- View history of identified songs

## Notes
- Works entirely on-device (no audio sent to Google)

- Updates music database periodically
- Cannot identify all songs

entries.title: pixel_photo_unblur.md
entries.content:
# Photo Unblur - Fix Blurry Photos

## Overview
AI sharpens blurry or out-of-focus photos, even old ones from other devices.

## When to Use
- Old photos from low-quality cameras
- Photos with slight motion blur
- Scanned printed photographs
- Inherited family photos

## Steps
- Open Google Photos
- Select blurry photo
- Tap Edit → Tools → Unblur
- AI processes and enhances sharpness
- Adjust intensity slider if needed
- Tap Save copy

## Notes
- Works on photos from any source
- Uses AI to reconstruct detail
- Best for slight blur, cannot fix severe blur
- Creates new copy, original preserved

entries.title: pixel_wifi_fix.md
entries.content:
# Fix Wi-Fi Connection Issues

## Overview
Troubleshoot Wi-Fi connectivity problems on Pixel.

## When to Use
- Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting
- Cannot connect to network
- Slow Wi-Fi speeds

## Steps
- Toggle Wi-Fi off and on
- Forget network: Settings → Network → Wi-Fi → Tap network → Forget
- Reconnect with password
- Restart phone
- Restart router/modem
- Reset network settings: Settings → System → Reset options → Reset Wi-Fi, mobile & Bluetooth

## Notes
- Check if other devices have same issue (router problem)
- Move closer to router
- Update phone software
- Factory reset as last resort
